testcases.name: fnet-base
testcases.prompt: The capital of France is Paris.
testcases.notes: FNet with 2D DFT via matrix multiplication. TRTMC remains FP16 while the official PyTorch reference uses FP32 because cuFFT cannot execute this non-power-of-two transform in FP16. The runtime pads static inputs with the checkpoint pad token so both sides transform identical 256-token inputs.
